payload.claim: Home Office accepts only an approved-provider SELT for most UK visas needing English
payload.quote: For most UK visas that ask for English, the Home Office accepts only a Secure English Language Test (SELT) from an approved provider.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI is on the approved SELT list
payload.quote: Pearson: PTE Academic UKVI and PTE Home.

payload.claim: Degree-level Student visa needs CEFR B2
payload.quote: For degree-level study on a Student visa you need English at CEFR B2.

payload.claim: Duolingo English Test is not a SELT and cannot be used where Home Office requires one
payload.quote: It is not a SELT, so it cannot be used where the Home Office asks for one.

payload.claim: IELTS accepted by over 13,500 organisations in 140+ countries
payload.quote: Accepted by over 13,500 institutions in more than 140 countries, IELTS is the most recognised test of its kind, and the most popular.

payload.claim: Only around 3,000 organisations accept PTE vs 13,500 for IELTS
payload.quote: In fact, over 13,500 organisations worldwide trust IELTS’ evaluation of English language skills while only around 3,000 organisations accept the PTE.

payload.claim: 85.7% of PTE Academic takers got results within 2 days in 2018 (standard PTE)
payload.quote: In fact, during 2018, 85.7% of PTE Academic test takers received their results within just 2 days.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI results often within 48 hours
payload.quote: Applicants looking for a fast and efficient testing process with quick results (often within 48 hours)

payload.claim: SELT result must be awarded in two years before applying
payload.quote: The result must have been awarded in the two years before the date you apply.

payload.claim: IELTS UKVI result must be under 12 months old at application
payload.quote: An IELTS for UKVI result must be less than 12 months old on the day you submit your visa application, while results from the other approved providers remain usable for the standard two years.

payload.claim: IELTS offers paper or computer; PTE computer only
payload.quote: This is because the PTE is available only on computer, whereas with IELTS you will have the flexibility to choose between taking your test on computer or paper in many locations globally.

payload.claim: UKVI versions have same content/format as standard tests
payload.quote: IELTS for UKVI and PTE Academic UKVI have the same content and format as the standard tests, so our IELTS and PTE Academic practice tests prepare you for them.

payload.claim: Sheffield accepts all IELTS qualifications for direct postgraduate entry
payload.quote: The University of Sheffield accepts all the qualifications listed on our English language requirements webpages, including all IELTS qualifications, for direct entry to its undergraduate and postgraduate degree courses.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI results typically take 7-10 working days
payload.quote: The UKVI version works differently: before release, every UKVI score is cross-checked against Home Office identity records, and results typically arrive in seven to ten working days.

payload.claim: Duolingo English Test UKVI added to SELT list early 2026
payload.quote: and, since it was added to the list in early 2026, the Duolingo English Test UKVI, a supervised version of the familiar adaptive test sat at approved centres.

payload.claim: Duplicate Pearson VUE account slows PTE results
payload.quote: Never create a duplicate Pearson VUE account as it will slow down the return of your results.

payload.claim: Universities may assess English themselves so can accept non-SELTs
payload.quote: This is why universities can accept tests that are not SELTs, such as TOEFL iBT, the Duolingo English Test or Cambridge C1 Advanced.
